title: Two expressions for edge expectation
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game and let $f$ be a real-valued function on its directed vertex-neighbor pairs. The expectation of $f$ over a uniformly chosen directed edge equals the expectation obtained by first choosing a vertex uniformly and then choosing one of its neighbors uniformly.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on directed vertex-neighbor pairs
